description: NaPO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.45 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.48 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.61 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.61 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one P atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₃P tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two P atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom.
